```lean
theorem lg_target {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ := by
  have hnz : n ≠ 0 := by contraposition hn; intro h; exact h.symm.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_even h)
  rw [Rat.addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow hnz hn]
  erw [AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℚ]
  erw [AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℤ]
```
